enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping under an extra blanket against the overnight cold snap
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pull extra blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up to chin. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Pull blanket. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a warm shower, then dressing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Step into shower. Apply soap. Rinse body. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Wash face at sink. Brush teeth. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a hot breakfast with kettle-boiled tea and toast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take out cup. Place tea bag in cup. Pour hot water into cup. Take toast from toaster. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking phone and computer for messages and the day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Pick up work bag. Place laptop in bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Open calendar. Check schedule. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Check email. Turn off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the office in the cold morning air
enriched_activities.desc: Put on coat. Put on shoes. Pick up work bag. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office on regular professional tasks and meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Print document. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss with colleagues. Return to desk. Make phone call. Write report.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the workplace
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to restaurant. Enter restaurant. Order food. Pay for food. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Exit restaurant. Walk back to office. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing office work, paperwork and afternoon meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Save spreadsheet. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss with supervisor. Return to desk. Review paperwork. Sign documents. File documents. Make phone calls.

Stand up from desk. Pack bag. Put on coat. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a warm dinner using the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Enter home. Put down bag. Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir vegetables. Add meat. Stir meat. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, washing up dishes and wiping down the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Pick up plates. Carry plates to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse dishes. Apply soap. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Eat snack. Drink water. Adjust cushion. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Step into shower. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk with the desk lamp on, using the computer for personal admin and messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open browser. Pay bills. Check social media. Write messages. Read news. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off bedroom light. Stand up. Walk to bed. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading on the phone and winding down for the night
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open reading app. Scroll through articles. Read article. Scroll to next article. Read article. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie on bed. Pull extra blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Pull blanket. Remain still.
